#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;
    std::vector<int> a;
    a.push_back(0);
    do {
        a.push_back(m % w);
        m /= w;
    } while (m > 0);
    int n = a.size() - 1;
    bool ok = true;
    int i = 1;
    while (i <= n) {
        if (a[i] > 1) {
            a[i] = a[i] + 1;
            if (a[i] == w) {
                while (i <= n && a[i] >= w) {
                    a[i] = 0;
                    i++;
                    if (i == a.size()) {
                        a.push_back(0);
                    }
                    a[i] = a[i] + 1;
                }
            } else {
                i++;
            }
            if (a[i-1] > 1) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        } else {
            i++;
        }
    }
    std::cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
